## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION ↓ falling (fear easing) and SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; Stocks vs Bonds (Level: 7.7109) RECOVERY ↑ rising adds confirmation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit mixed: HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND → credit markets showing resilience while credit spread Level (0.7259) is flat RECOVERY. Energy/commodity strength: BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND supporting cyclical momentum.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing. UUP (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY ↑ rising dollar; TLT (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND → bonds still bid 1M, but SPY/TLT rising (1W +1.48%) points to equity preference near-term.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities also strong: XLU (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging on 1M: XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY — style: Cyclicals favored vs Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
Emerging markets strong: EEM (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND; US broad market holding: SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND. Japan mixed: EWJ (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +7.89%) CORRECTION highlighting regional divergences.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative risk mixed but present: ARKK (1W: +4.44% | 1M: -10.96%) RECOVERY and IBIT (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -24.83%) RECOVERY show short-term bounces but larger 1M drawdowns.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity strength led by oil and industrials: BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND; Gold holding: GLD (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +5.64%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy clearly strong: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and broad sector breadth (9/11) confirm cyclical leadership. DIVERGENCE: XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY and VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION create short-term rhythm mismatches to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and commodity-linked exposure (XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to tech beta if 1M weakness persists (XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY). Bonds neutral-to-constructive: TLT (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND — monitor oil price action. BEARISH: XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY — watch for tech 1M follow-through.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND — energy-led cyclical impulse. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND — gas remains weak.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) — current VIX 28.37 (1W: -3.01% | 1M: +9.12%) CORRECTION; HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 for credit health while HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND; XLK/market momentum pivot if XLK 1M fails to re-accelerate.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION and SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND confirm. Energy and cyclicals (XLE, XLB) showing strength while tech (XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY) is the key divergence to monitor.
